title: Hot Works Permit
name: Hot Works Permit
description: Permit for welding, cutting, grinding, brazing, torch-on roofing and other ignition-producing work, including pre-work fire controls, fire watch and post-work inspection.

sections.title: PRE-WORK FIRE AND EXPLOSION CONTROLS
items: Combustible materials have been removed or suitably protected within the area affected by sparks, flame and heat
Floors, walls, ceilings, openings and concealed voids have been checked for combustible materials and fire spread paths
Areas above, below and on the opposite side of partitions / floors have been assessed where heat or sparks could migrate
Flammable liquids, gases, aerosols and pressurised containers have been removed or made safe
Potential explosive atmospheres and DSEAR controls have been considered where relevant
Suitable fire extinguishing equipment is immediately available
Escape routes and fire doors remain available and unobstructed
The work area is segregated to protect other workers and the public

fields.label: Combustibles Removed / Protected and Adjacent Areas Checked
Fire Extinguisher Type, Quantity and Location

sections.title: GAS CYLINDERS, EQUIPMENT AND VENTILATION
items: Hot work equipment, leads, hoses, regulators and flashback protection have been checked before use
Gas cylinders are secured upright, protected from heat / damage and positioned safely
Fuel gas and oxygen cylinders / hoses are controlled to prevent leaks and unsafe storage
Ventilation is sufficient for welding fumes, gases and process emissions
Local exhaust ventilation or respiratory protection is provided where required by the assessment
Equipment is isolated and removed / secured when work stops

fields.label: Hot Work Equipment / Cylinder Check Details

sections.title: FIRE ALARM / DETECTOR ISOLATION
items: Fire detection will remain operational unless isolation is necessary for the work
Any fire alarm / detector isolation has been specifically authorised and limited to the minimum area / time
Compensatory fire controls are in place while detection is isolated
The person responsible for reinstatement is identified before work starts

sections.title: DURING-WORK FIRE WATCH
items: The named fire watcher is present and able to stop the work if unsafe conditions develop
The fire watcher is not undertaking duties that prevent effective observation
Sparks, slag, heat transfer and smoke migration are continuously monitored
Adjacent levels, voids and opposite sides of surfaces are checked where necessary
Hot work stops immediately if fire controls become ineffective or conditions change

sections.title: POST-WORK FIRE WATCH AND RE-INSPECTION
items: The immediate work area and all relevant adjacent areas have been inspected on completion
The fire watch continues for the period defined by the fire risk assessment / site procedure
Concealed spaces and surfaces affected by heat have been checked for smouldering or hotspots
A final re-inspection is completed before the permit is closed
Any hotspot, smoke or fire concern is treated as an emergency and the permit remains open until resolved

fields.label: Required Post-work Fire Watch Duration / Basis

sections.title: REINSTATEMENT AND CLOSE-OUT
items: Any isolated fire detection has been fully reinstated and status confirmed
Gas cylinders and hot work equipment have been removed or safely stored
Fire-resistant screens, blankets and temporary controls have been removed only when safe
The area is free from fire / heat hazards and safe for hand-back
Permit issuer and holder agree the permit can be closed
